title: Embedding a configuration built from words
statement: Let $m\le k$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $B$ and $SS$ be types, let $\mathrm{inject}:SS\to B$, let $q\in SS$, and let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each of the $m$ work tapes. Embedding the configuration built from $q$ and $w$ into a machine with $k$ work tapes and states in $B$ gives the configuration built from $\mathrm{inject}(q)$ whose first $m$ tapes contain the corresponding words and whose remaining tapes are blank.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers m and k with m ≤ k
A family of Boolean words indexed by Fin m
